Per-character loop over a2: a3 accumulates the advance returned by sub_552910(this, a2[v15], a3, a4, a5) for each character.
ArithmeticComparison_0f90(dword_8B78A0, this+0xC descriptor) finalizes the locked vertex-buffer region after character rendering.
When dword_8B8DF0 is clear, VTableGetterWrapper(dword_8B78A0) is invoked before the buffer format call.
